## Method and sources

Apparent fishing activity is estimated from AIS (Global Fishing Watch v3.0, 2023)
and measured in hours. Hotspot cells are ranked by summed grid hours; cell area
varies with latitude. The scaffold reconciles to `r total_millions` million hours.
